lines.text: I’m the author of The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck (20M+ copies, 70+ languages) and a…
📚 3x #1 NYTimes Bestselling Author 🌎 Founder & Chief Growth Officer @purpose.app 🎙️ Host of the @solvedpodcast

Comment EMOTIONS and I’ll send you my free guide to understanding your emotions, where they come from, and how to stop letting them quietly run the show. Your brain is incredibly good at explaining decisions after the fact. A lot of what we call “logic” is just us building a convincing argument for something we already felt, wanted, or believed.
Adulthood starts when you stop waiting to be saved.

Comment CHARM and I’ll send you my free Dating Guide on spotting red flags, choosing healthier partners, and recognizing the behaviors that usually get worse over time. Charm can be faked. Boundaries are harder to fake around. If you want to know who someone really is, pay attention to what happens when they don’t get their way.

If you liked this, comment BOND and I’ll send you my free guide to building deeper, longer-lasting relationships. You still need to like the person when romance takes a back seat for a while. That happens in every long marriage.

Comment PEACE and I’ll send you my free Happiness Guide on finding more joy in everyday life and figuring out what actually makes you feel fulfilled. A good life usually doesn’t feel exciting every second. Most of the time, it looks like quiet routines, people you love, and ordinary moments you’re actually present enough to enjoy.
Monday in my newsletter we are going to talk about: Who do you surround yourself with?. Link in bio to subscribe.

Comment TOXIC, and I'll send you the episode. If toxic relationships are all you've ever known, healthy love can feel boring. When you're used to chaos, you start mistaking anxiety for chemistry and stability for a lack of passion. Sometimes, the love you actually need feels unfamiliar. @solvedpodcast
Nobody has to say you can't do something for it to shrink what you attempt, they just have to expect less of you long enough.

Comment FEEL and I’ll send you my free Emotions Guide on understanding what you feel, regulating your reactions, and becoming more emotionally self-aware. Emotional intelligence is knowing what you’re feeling, understanding where it’s coming from, and handling it without making everyone else responsible for it.

Comment COMMITMENT and I'll send you the Commitment Guide, a free walkthrough on where you're avoiding commitment and what it's actually costing you. Waiting for the "right" person, the right job or the right moment feels smart and responsible. But at some point, being careful becomes the excuse you use to avoid risking anything real. The person who commits to something imperfect but builds it anyway will always end up ahead of the person who spent those same years waiting to feel certain. Stop waiting to feel ready. @solvedpodcast

Comment FLAGS and I’ll send you my free Dating Guide on spotting red flags, choosing better partners, and avoiding the people who are charming for five minutes and exhausting for five years. Confidence is attractive because certainty feels safe. The problem is that narcissism can wear the exact same costume at first, what looks magnetic on date one can become selfishness, control, and chaos once the charm wears off.
